evidence.quote: Submit the following documents: - Passport sized photo - Copy of the photo-page(s) of your passport - High School Diploma - Transcript of Records - Medical Certificate - Curriculum Vitae in English - Motivation Letter - Portfolio - Recommendation letters, more documentation etc. – optional submission
A motivation letter must be added to your application.

notes: Application deadline 30 June 2027 is quoted from the programme page for the 2027/28 academic year: no quote describes it as specifically for non-EU/foreign applicants, so it is recorded here rather than as a fact. The 1 July 2027 deadline from the Admission Office is a document-submission deadline, not an application deadline, and is also not labelled for non-EU applicants. The programme page states an application fee of 150 USD (one-time). The tuition is quoted as USD 3,400 per semester; USD is not one of the allowed currencies for the tuition fact, so the amount was recorded but flagged here for audit. Stipendium Hungaricum is available according to the University of Pécs programme listing, but as the applicant applies via the University of Pécs online application site the application channel is recorded as hu-university-direct.

note.fr: Un entretien en ligne (oral) est requis dans le cadre de la procédure d'admission; préparez-vous à cet entretien.
note.en: An online interview (oral) is required as part of the admission process; prepare for this interview.
